clue.text: Habit of old labourer to have to drink warm salt water

indicators.note: to drink means to take in, so the other pieces take the sea inside them

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker or labourer
to own something is to have it
the Med, the Mediterranean, is a warm salty sea

explanation.surface: An old farmhand has to sip a warm brine, perhaps as a remedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Habit' is a garment here, not a custom: clothing worn before by someone else.
explanation.definitionFit: Second-hand clothing passed on from an older sibling is a habit, or garment, of old ownership.

clue.text: What ends with you solving the Jumbo

indicators.note: ends says to take the final letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: What is the outcome when you finish the giant puzzle?
explanation.definitionFit: Jumbo means very large, a synonym of enormous.

clue.text: Sport to be arranged with female boxing

indicators.note: boxing says the name encloses the other piece

parts.note: Nell is a girl's name, a female

explanation.surface: A sporting fixture is still to be fixed, featuring women's boxing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be arranged' looks like an anagram signal but gives the abbreviation TBA.
explanation.definitionFit: Netball is a team sport, mainly played by women, where goals are scored through a ring.

clue.text: Time to be seen in posh car — Mini strangely put off people

indicators.note: to be seen in says the time letter is placed inside the rearranged letters
strangely says the letters are rearranged into an odd order

explanation.surface: A snob avoids being seen in a small car, preferring a posh one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strangely' scrambles POSH CAR plus MINI, and 'to be seen in' drops T inside the result.
explanation.definitionFit: A misanthropic person dislikes humankind, so is repelled by other people.

clue.text: Patient investigator keeps one grounded, beginning to search for objects

indicators.note: keeps says the doctor holds the flightless bird inside

parts.note: a doctor, DR, investigates a patient's ailments
the emu is a flightless bird, kept on the ground

indicators.note: beginning to says take the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A detective with endless patience holds someone down and starts looking for items.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Patient investigator' suggests a patient detective, but it is a doctor investigating a patient.
explanation.definitionFit: To demur is to raise doubts or protest, as one objects.

clue.text: More bleak land one refuses to give up

parts.note: to land a prize is to win it
a trier is one who keeps trying and does not quit

explanation.surface: A bleaker landscape belongs to someone who won't surrender.
explanation.definitionFit: Wintrier means colder and more cheerless, as bleak weather is.

clue.text: Skewer points the wrong way

indicators.note: the wrong way says the word for points is read backwards

parts.note: tips are points, the sharp ends of things

explanation.surface: A kebab skewer has its sharp points facing the wrong way.
explanation.definitionFit: A spit is a long rod pushed through meat for roasting, a kind of skewer.

clue.text: City buried English couple after ceremony

indicators.note: after says the English couple follows the ceremony

parts.note: pomp is splendid ceremonial display
II is two in Roman numerals, a couple

explanation.surface: An English pair were laid to rest after a formal ceremony.
explanation.definitionFit: Pompeii was a Roman city buried by the eruption of Vesuvius in AD 79.

clue.text: First Lady launched fresh takeover, keeping quiet

indicators.note: keeping says the scrambled letters hold the quiet signal
fresh says the letters are made anew in another order

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet

explanation.surface: A president's wife starts a new takeover bid while keeping it hush-hush.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First Lady' suggests a president's wife; she was the first woman launched into space, in 1963.
explanation.definitionFit: Valentina Tereshkova was the first woman in space, so the first lady launched.

clue.text: Grand English celebrities recalled in the garden

indicators.note: in says the reversed celebrities sit inside the word that follows

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: recalled is read as called back, so the word for celebrities runs backwards

parts.note: big names are celebrities

explanation.surface: Grand English celebrities are remembered at a garden party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' is the reversal signal, read as called back; 'garden' at the end looks like a setting but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The Garden of Gethsemane is where Jesus prayed before his arrest, a famous biblical garden.

clue.text: Ruler appearing before twelve tax collectors

parts.note: a.m. is the time before twelve noon
IR is the Inland Revenue, the old British tax authority

explanation.surface: A ruler shows up ahead of a dozen tax collectors.
explanation.walkthrough: IR is the Inland Revenue, the former name of the British tax collecting office.
explanation.definitionFit: An amir, or emir, is a Muslim ruler or commander.

clue.text: Sticking quality grub up by natural lake

parts.note: to stub is to dig up roots or stumps, to grub up
a born leader is a natural one
Loch Ness is a famous Scottish lake

explanation.surface: Food for the gourmet is close to a lake of natural beauty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grub' looks like food, but 'grub up' is the verb meaning to dig out by the roots.
explanation.definitionFit: Stubbornness is the quality of sticking to one's position, obstinacy.

clue.text: Film makers run into trouble when interrupting advisers

indicators.note: when interrupting says one piece breaks into the middle of the advisers

parts.note: people who warn are advisers of danger

indicators.note: into says the run letter goes inside the word for trouble

parts.note: bother is trouble or fuss
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Movie producers get into difficulty by cutting across their consultants.
explanation.walkthrough: Two containers nest: 'into' signals the first and 'when interrupting' the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Warner Brothers is a major Hollywood studio, a company that makes films.

clue.text: One disappearing from sight in a cruiser solvent again

indicators.note: in says the shortened sight goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: a boater is one who cruises in a boat

indicators.note: disappearing from says the letter for one is removed from the word for sight

parts.note: a view is a sight
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone vanishes from view aboard a cruise ship, back on an even keel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'solvent' looks like a chemistry word, but here it means able to pay debts.
explanation.definitionFit: Above water is an idiom for out of debt, so solvent again after hard times.

clue.text: Awkward high ball moving backward, not forward

indicators.note: moving backward says the word for a high ball is read in reverse

parts.note: a lob is a ball hit high into the air
shy means reserved, not forward

explanation.surface: A tennis player lobs a high ball that drifts back, being timid at the net.
explanation.definitionFit: Bolshy is British slang for uncooperative or difficult, an awkward attitude.

clue.text: Reliable chap following angry-looking university type

indicators.note: following says the reliable chap comes after the angry-looking word

parts.note: a face goes red with anger
a brick is an old-fashioned term for a dependable fellow

explanation.surface: A trusty fellow trails behind someone flushed with rage.
explanation.walkthrough: A brick, in dated British slang, is a thoroughly dependable person. A redbrick is a British university founded in the late 19th or early 20th century, as opposed to Oxford or Cambridge.
explanation.definitionFit: Redbrick describes the Victorian civic universities of British industrial cities, a type of university.

clue.text: Monitor elderly relative getting in way, not moving

indicators.note: getting in says the other pieces go inside the word for way

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
a tag is an electronic device that monitors an offender
nan is a grandmother

explanation.surface: A carer keeps an eye on a granny who is in the way and won't budge.
explanation.definitionFit: Stagnant water is still and not flowing, so motionless.

clue.text: Film director, unusually, is TV icon

indicators.note: unusually says the letters are arranged in an unusual order

explanation.surface: A film director is, unusually, a television icon.
explanation.definitionFit: Luchino Visconti was an Italian film director, maker of The Leopard.

clue.text: Separate and better info was illuminating

parts.note: SP, the starting price, is information for a punter, one who bets
lit up means lit or illuminated, past tense

explanation.surface: A divided pair and some improved information that shed light.
explanation.walkthrough: 'better' reads as an adjective but means a bettor, a gambler, whose information is the SP or starting price.
explanation.definitionFit: To split up is to part company or separate.

clue.text: Runs charters to see Russian city

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
OS, the Ordnance Survey, is Britain's official map-maker, so a charter in the sense of one who charts
taken as written
v is short for vide, Latin for see

explanation.surface: A tour operator lays on charter flights to visit a Russian city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charters' reads as charter flights but means people who make charts: the Ordnance Survey, Britain's national mapping agency.
explanation.definitionFit: Rostov-on-Don is a large city in southern Russia on the River Don.

clue.text: Speaker has little cutting to say when leader is away

indicators.note: cutting says the little piece goes into the shortened word
when leader is away says the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: to utter is to say
wee is Scottish for little

explanation.surface: A speaker has a small clipping to share while the boss is absent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Speaker' suggests a person talking; it is a loudspeaker for high notes.
explanation.definitionFit: A tweeter is a small loudspeaker for high frequencies.

clue.text: Officer's superior to take this fuse

indicators.note: superior to means placed above, as in a down entry

parts.note: CO stands for commanding officer, with the possessive linking
here is what is said when handing something over, take this

explanation.surface: A soldier's commander must accept this explosive fuse.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry, 'superior to' places CO above HERE.
explanation.definitionFit: To cohere is to stick together or unite, as things fuse.

clue.text: Hurt using pins

parts.note: pins is slang for legs, so the clue describes injured people still able to move on foot, not something done with sewing pins

explanation.surface: Someone was injured with sharp pins.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes casualties who are injured but able to walk without a stretcher.

clue.text: Raffle is very attractive event

definitions.meaning: a lottery in which tickets are pulled out to pick winners
an attraction that pulls in big crowds

explanation.definitionFit: A draw is a lottery and also an event that attracts the public.

clue.text: Statesman once put round letter with flyer

parts.note: a tit is a small bird, a flyer
the letter O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A former politician put a letter on a pigeon's leg.
explanation.definitionFit: Josip Broz Tito was the leader of Yugoslavia, a statesman of the past.

clue.text: One has lead to walk dog

parts.note: to pace is to walk steadily
a setter is a breed of gun dog

explanation.surface: Someone holds the lead when taking the dog out for a walk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lead' looks like a dog's leash, but it means being in front.
explanation.definitionFit: A pacesetter is the runner who leads and sets the speed, so one who holds the lead.

clue.text: Maybe like painter's retrospective series of twenty portraits

indicators.note: retrospective says the hidden letters are read backwards
series of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An artist holds a retrospective showing a run of twenty portraits.
explanation.walkthrough: A painter is also the rope that ties up a small boat, so something like it might be described as rope-like.
explanation.definitionFit: Ropy means like rope, and a boat's painter is a rope, so it fits as an example.

clue.text: Small mammal emerging from tree throws nuts

indicators.note: nuts means crazy, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A small creature comes out of a tree and hurls nuts.
explanation.definitionFit: The otter shrew is a small semi-aquatic African mammal.
